profile.headline: Web Developer  at Henry Schein
profile.summary:
Seeking a professional position with a qualified organization that can utilize my proven skills in computer operations, customer relations, network engineering, escalation support, network administration and systems administration.

Languages	 - HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AJAX, VB Access 2007, C#, ASP.net
OS & Enterprise Apps -  IBM Mainframes, UNIX. Linux, AS400,SYS80/85, OS/390, RS6000, HP-9000, HP-3000, Solaris, SAP, Legato, VERITAS, Windows 2003 Server, Exchange Server 2007, Cisco IOS, Norton Anti-virus, ISA firewall, Proxy Server,Volusion, X-cart/(Litecommerce), digshop, oscommerce or zend VM Ware, Terminal Server, Citrix, Net Backup, Backup-Exec, RAID, SCSI, Active Directory, DNS, WINS, DHCP, RIS, GPMC, RRAS, IIS
Network Technologies - Cisco routers, switches, Ethernet, Fast Ethernet, WAN, LAN, TCP/IP, CDP, RIP, RIPv2, OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, VTP, VLAN, VTP, HSRP, STP, SVI, CEF, Frame-relay, PPP, Access Control List (ACL), Network Address Translation (NAT), Port Address Translation (PAT), Redistribution, OSPF Virtual links, GRE Tunnel
Desktop Technologies  - Windows 95+/XP/VISTA, Microsoft Word, Excel, Access, Power Point, Internet Explorer, Mozilla Firefox, Opera, Scanners, Desktop and Networked Printers.

Specialties: An excellent IT professional who like to face challenges and be successful in all task. Hardworker, honest and fair individual who seeks only to be at the top of the best. I am flexible and  bilingual in chinesse - Mandarin. I am fully aware of all culture and is able to adapt to any environment.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Develop new Web applications as identified by  management through packaged and customized applications. Maintain and enhance existing Web applications and all internal systems are integrated. Perform complete testing of Web applications unit and system, engaging users as necessary. Conduct all user acceptances testing, and report results. Design and implement user-driven templates, databases and interfaces for ease of use. Develop database-driven Web interfaces for rapid, real-time information sharing. Develop external Web portals allowing users to input and retrieve accurate information. Participate in dynamic priority setting sessions as the summer season unfolds.

positions.title: Domestic Operations Specialist IV
positions.description: Monitor, track, and inspect inbound freight to meet customers' needs,  ensure freight is delivered on time in the most cost efficient manner, route, track, and investigate shipping problems, and follow-up with customers, inspect inbound and/or outbound freight, quote rates, processes, and documents shipment orders, prepare paperwork for routing, close out files and send documents out on a timely basis, communicate pick-ups requested by customers to dispatch, inform customers of arrival and departures of freight, collect data and assemble into proper format, provide outstanding customer service internally and externally on assigned accounts, resolve issues as they occur related to cargo movement/transactions, analyze report data for trends and work with Account Services Supervisor/Manager to develop, implement and execute corrective action plans, coordinate cargo flow with related internal parties, monitor specific customer’s cargo flow through CEVA’s supply chain.

positions.title: Gateway Specialist IV
positions.description: Manage export transactions, including all related activities for an assigned base of accounts. Set priorities for team, expediting transactions and task to meek customer expectations and government requirements. Monitor the equality of services including documents produced by the team. Design and coordinate implementations for exportation. Oversee all aspect of high volume accounts relating to the transportation of goods and the maintenance of the client’s needs. Work with clients to establish detailed profiles and procedures that properly represents their export procedures. Primary Duties and Responsibilities also includes receiving , reviewing , and processing documentation, print electronically transmitted Pre-Alerts from the tracking system, follow-up on freight availability and status,  review arriving freight documents, checking for discrepancies,  arrange, book, and confirm cargo space on flights,  advise supervisor of any problems, prepare documents for consolidation of freight, close files and distribute documents in accordance with established procedures and in compliance with applicable standards, and  models and acts in accordance with our guiding principles and core values.

positions.title: Air Export Specialist / Account Coordinator
positions.description:
Develop and maintain excellent service to internal and external customers, oversee, train and advise team members and clients in areas of export administration regulations, consularization regulations, other government agency regulations, and export services, create and develop written procedures for handling each account served by the team.  Manage the appropriate databases to reflect these procedures, receive, review and process high volume, and/or complex export transactions for assigned base of accounts, process data through the established export system, obtaining consular release and other government agency releases as appropriate; prepare invoices for the export account, review and monitor all Shipper Export Declaration rejections, requests for information from clients, government agencies, and other correspondence, work with clients to establish detailed profiles and procedures that properly represent their export process, communicate changes of U.S. and foreign shipping regulations and procedures to clients, alert clients of special areas of concern or potential problems in their export process. 
Reply to overseas inquiries in a clear, concise and timely manner, maintain clear verbal and written communication with clients, and provide excellent and timely customer service by proactively informing clients of the status of their shipments, trace and track customer's freight, maintain contact with the airlines, trucking companies and any agents that will be handling the freight to ensure shipper and consignees are aware of any problems, provide proof of delivery, responsible for processing pick-up requests and entering data in the system, respond to and handle all daily customer service requests, notify customers of any delays in shipping and dispatching points, enter shipment data in system, prepare rates and invoices House.

positions.title: Technical Support Representative
positions.description:
To provide professional, courteous, responsive and accurate service to our customers. 
Responsible for providing customer service support on Cablevision products to achieve high levels of customer satisfaction. 
Effective and efficient handling of customer transactions in real time including, but not limited to: working simultaneously with multiple software applications; immediate/direct keyboarding into customer service information systems; consistently following up on promises and commitments on a timely basis; and appropriately identify and escalate unresolved issues. 
Provide routine customer service billing support including, but not limited to: explaining billing statements to customers, taking customer payments for service, handling collection issues, pro-rates, issuing credits, handling changes of service, confirming appointments, and as required, perform basic troubleshooting procedures. 
Effectively communicate, using customer friendly and appropriate language, to explain customer bills, payment issues and handle billing disputes consistent with Cablevision standards. 
Consistently and accurately document to databases as required (i.e., Cabledata, KDB forms, etc.). 
Maintain effective working knowledge of collection processes. 
On a daily basis, keep current and informed on all informational sources available (i.e., KDB, field communications, training documents, etc.). 
Perform all work-related tasks, including escalation of issues, in a manner that is in compliance with all Cablevision values, policies and procedures. 
Identify and handle as appropriate, upgrade and retention opportunities. 
Consistently meet all delivery, technical, productivity, and process goals consistent with your grade level requirements. 
Participate in special projects and perform other duties as assigned

positions.title: Sr. Computer Operator
positions.description: Responsible for monitoring, administration and escalation support of all Computer Operation Functions and peripherals in the IT department, and ensure that the various computer platforms are functional/operational at all times, respond to any system errors. Malfunctions, and abnormality in a timely manner, respond to all auto system scheduler production and non production schedules, process payroll, generate, archive and distribute weekly, monthly and daily reports, perform full and  incremental backups on systems on a daily, weekly and monthly basis,  perform helpdesks duties to customer, employee and drivers,  prepare mailbags every day and assigned them to truck for delivery to the depots, excellent customer service, Training, and all other projects such as conversions and upgrades.
